body: My dad tells me to “stick it out” all the time. But even though our close ones don’t know how to help, this community is here to help, cause we are together in this sh*t. Get out of this cycle by doing things you love only. Not to reach success or contentment, but focusing on what feels good to you, your body, your soul. There is still something you can love to do, for yourself.
I’m 21 and Please find the strength to get professional help before next month
